sources.constraint_header:
/*
Package gorgonia is a library that helps facilitate machine learning in Go.
Write and evaluate mathematical equations involving multidimensional arrays easily.
Do differentiation with them just as easily.
*/
package gorgonia

module gorgonia.org/gorgonia

go 1.25.0

require (
	github.com/Artyomkun/gorgonia.org/vecf64 v1.0.0
	github.com/Artyomkun/gorgonia.org/vecf32 v1.0.0
	github.com/Artyomkun/gorgonia.org/tensor v1.0.0
	github.com/Artyomkun/gorgonia.org/gorgonia/internal/encoding v1.0
	github.com/Artyomkun/gorgonia.org/gorgonia/cuda v1.0.0
	github.com/awalterschulze/gographviz v2.0.3+incompatible
	github.com/chewxy/hm v1.0.0
	github.com/chewxy/math32 v1.11.2
	github.com/leesper/go_rng v0.0.0-20190531154944-a612b043e353
	github.com/pkg/errors v0.9.1
	github.com/xtgo/set v1.0.0
	gonum.org/v1/gonum v0.17.0
)
